messages:
emma: Heads-up for folks flying to Austin next week 6a81fa1f84b8 
Quick poll: who brings a neck pillow vs tries to sleep without? Also any quick commuter tips for getting from airport to downtown cheaply?

raj: Neck pillow all the way. Compact inflatable one fits in backpack. For airport->downtown, shuttle apps sometimes cheaper than taxis. Check local transit passes too.

mike: I skip the pillow and use a folded hoodie + hoodie pockets as head props. Cheaper and multi-use. For luggage: bring a small lock for checked bags. Too many stories about mixed-up tags.

claire: If you're doing rideshare, toggle "airport pickup" rules in app to avoid surge. Also pack a day outfit in carry-on in case checked goes missing.

travel-bot: Tip: Austin fare estimate: airport to downtown ~ $25-35 by rideshare off-peak. Capital Metro bus cheaper (~$1.50) but check schedules.

emma: Good calls. One more: do people prefer packing cubes labeled per day or by clothing type?

raj: By day for conferences. Saves time getting dressed between sessions.

mike: By type for longer trips. Depends on how many outfit swaps you do.

claire: Bring a small stain stick for quick shirt emergencies. Lifesaver after spilled coffee in workshops.

emma: Love that. Final: meetup at 6:30pm after day 1 near the hotel bar? Quick thumbs: +1 to confirm.

raj: +1

mike: +1

travel-bot: Poll created: "Day 1 meetup 6:30pm hotel bar". Results: 3 yes.

emma: Great, I'll post exact details in the dinners thread. See you all! :beers:
